name: image
title: Image
description: A picture the business publishes, such as a product photo or a banner.

files.image.yaml:
unoverse: "1.0"
# A picture the business publishes. Positioned by the service or need it represents, written as
# service copy in the business's vocabulary, never as a description of the scene (the one
# deliberate exception to strict grounding, so a picture lands beside the needs it serves).
type: object
name: image
element: content
# THE GLYPH its rows are drawn with (README 4a): a lucide icon name.
icon: image
extends: need
uniqueBy: [source_url]
embed: [title, description, key_need, related_needs, questions, callToAction]
search: [universal_id, object_type, title, description, key_need, source_url, source_id]
meta: open

# THE FACE, as a node's node.yaml carries it: what this is and when an Agent reaches for it.
title: Image
description: >-
  A picture the business publishes, such as a product photo or a banner.
whenToUse: >-
  Show me what it looks like. Is there a picture of it? Let me see it.
category: Objects
version: 1.0.0

props: { $include: props }
files.props.yaml:
# AN IMAGE'S OWN FIELDS. Its source_url is the image itself. A picture a document holds is a
# `figure` (2026-09-14), a part of its document, off the map; an image is published and on it.
visualElements:
  type: array
  input: true
  description: >-
    What is in the picture, three to eight things, each a noun phrase.
  minItems: 3
  maxItems: 8
  items:
    type: string
colors:
  type: array
  input: true
  description: >-
    The dominant colours, two to five, as plain colour names.
  minItems: 2
  maxItems: 5
  items:
    type: string
